title: Require Service Module And Private-Source Isolation
forbids: computed module sources, sibling-module entry, contract type extraction outside the contract composer, arbitrary root entry into module implementation, module entry into root execution, and cross-service private source imports
why: A service root composes modules, each module owns its interior, and service-to-service collaboration crosses only the public client boundary.
remediate: Use a literal module source, keep behavior inside its owning module, let handler contextual typing prove operation input/output assignability, compose only contract and router faces at the service root, and replace private cross-service imports with the owner's public client.
message: Service modules and private implementation must remain sealed behind their owning composition faces.
